Mia (CS): Heads-up: prepping QBR for Caspian Labs next Wed. Observed weird token spikes in onboarding cohort. Sharing thread for runbook and owners.
BillingBot: ALERT — Caspian Labs (acct: CAS-889) usage spike: 3.2M tokens in 24h, spend $4.1k. Threshold hit: 70% of monthly budget.
Sam (FinOps): Noted. Current month spend $18.2k, committed $50k. If spike continues, projected month-end ~$42k (~84% of commit).
Alex (SE): Do we have a session-level token distribution query? I can run quick cohort analysis.
Alex (SE): ```sql
SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM events
WHERE account='CAS-889' AND timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Jordan (CSM): I can run an enablement with their infra folks — they mentioned switching to embeddings-heavy pipeline last week.
Mia (CS): Action items: Alex run cohort query; Sam update forecast + tweak alert thresholds; Jordan schedule 30m enablement with customer + SE. I'll capture notes for the QBR deck.
Alex (SE): Query queued, will post top 5 sessions in ~10m.
Alex (SE): Top sessions (30d window): onboarding-batch-1: 980k tokens; ingest-worker-3: 640k; experiment-collector: 530k; realtime-proxy: 210k; api-test-harness: 150k.
Sam (FinOps): Adjusted forecast: baseline $18.2k -> projected $42k month-end if current cadence holds. Recommend: temporary soft-throttle at route-level OR per-account token cap + alert. Also embedding caching could cut calls by ~25-30%.
Jordan (CSM): I'll weave caching + batching best-practices into the enablement. Also capturing feedback: they want lower tail latency for small queries — may resist batch in some routes.
Mia (CS): Noted the tradeoff. For QBR we'll present three options: 1) Embedding dedupe & caching (~25% savings), 2) Route-specific quantized model for cheap paths (~15% savings), 3) Per-route soft quotas + spike alerts (operational guardrail).
Sam (FinOps): I'll prepare a slide with scenario-based forecasts (baseline / spike / mitigated) + run sensitivity. Also propose alert channels: slack + email + billing webhook.
Mia (CS): Owners & deadlines: Alex = analysis (EOD Thu), Sam = forecast + guardrails (EOD Thu), Jordan = enablement + feedback capture (enablement Thu 10am PT), Mia = QBR deck (prep by Fri EOD).
Jordan (CSM): Invite sent to customer + SE for Thu 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Mia (CS): Thanks — will compile all artifacts into the QBR folder. If Alex posts raw CSV, I'll attach it.
Alex (SE): Posting CSV link: https://redwood.internal/cs-reports/CAS-889-top-sessions.csv
Mia (CS): Perfect. We'll update the renewal-risk flag to 'monitor' until mitigations are applied. Keep me posted. :eyes:
